Maria Chen: quick preflight: pushing RN + canary plan for 23:50 UTC window. Need ops ack and a rollback owner.

Kevin Liu: scanning now. what are the rollback triggers?

Maria Chen: proposed: auto-abort if error-rate > 2.5% or embedding invalids > 4%. manual rollback if p99 +12% sustained for 5m or any dedicated OOMs.

Sasha Ortiz: SDK teams: embedding metadata adds `embedding_metadata.version` (additive). I'll notify them.

Kevin Liu: DeployBot, schedule a 10% canary at 23:50 UTC, hold at 00:15 UTC.

DeployBot: scheduled -> 10% @23:50 UTC, hold @00:15 UTC. Link: https://deployboard.internal/canary/1829998888 Reaction: :rocket:

Sasha Ortiz: QA will run `./smoke --canary=10` before hold. If >3 failures, we hold and escalate.

Maria Chen: internal RN snippet for #all-hands: "Heads-up: rolling deployment tonight 23:50 UTC (10% canary). Changes: minor streaming fix, model pin updates, and an additive embedding metadata field. Expected progression: 10% -> hold -> full rollout if checks pass."

Kevin Liu: nit: change "full rollout" to "full rollout (if healthy)".

Maria Chen: updated. final checklist: legal ok, deploybot scheduled, dashboards pinned, SDK notified. If no objections, posting T-2h.

Kevin Liu: no objections. I'll own rollback if needed.

Sasha Ortiz: ack. will monitor smoke + SDK alerts.

DeployBot: standing by for `deploybot promote` or `deploybot rollback`.
